title: report-order — the Asks tab becomes a ranked hierarchy, band order included

set.request: make the report this whole visual navigation — a hierarchy of requests and tasks and projects and links and previews. Order it and rank it in terms of the quantity of work or the potential outcome; a lot of the things I've asked are side tangential things, footnotes further down the page.
set.now: landing: docs updated, the topics rank line appended, private server killed
steps: read the Asks tab and ranking machinery
add a topics rank list that orders the bands, with a grip on each heading
add a fold field to the rank verb so a band can hide its tail under "N more"
each band heading shows its own landed/building/open counts
document the two additions beside the rank verb and in doc/ranking.md and doc/asks.md
verify headless on the private server: 5 bands, the fold, 400/1280/1920, zero console errors
append the topics rank line into the mastermind's own task log through the seam
set.outcome:
**The Asks tab is now a ranked hierarchy, top to bottom: bands ranked by outcome, cards ranked inside them, and a fold for the tangents.** A `rank` line with `list: "topics"` now orders the five bands themselves (grip on the heading, same drag as a card), so the biggest-outcome topic leads and the rest fall away — on the run this was built against that line now reads `Layouts, Design system, Pages, AI log, Ask`, live. A band can also carry `fold` on its own `asks` rank line, tucking everything past the Nth card under an "N more" bar the reader opens — the owner's own words, "footnotes further down the page" — with the folded cards still ordinary, still draggable, just CSS-hidden until opened. Every band heading now shows its own landed/building/open counts, so the shape of a run reads before a single card is clicked.

![the run task, band-ordered](band-order.png)

Live: [the run task, in the new order](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/mastermind-layout-browser/) (five bands, 46 cards right now — the mastermind is still adding asks live) · [doc/ranking.md](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/ranking/) (Band order + Footnotes) · [doc/asks.md](/framework/ext/AITask/doc/asks/) · [doc/task-jsonl.md](/framework/ext/JSONL/doc/task-jsonl/) (the verb).

Verified headless on a private server (port 8121, killed by its real PID both times): the real run task renders the five bands in the new order with zero console errors and zero horizontal overflow at 400/1280/1920; an in-browser fixture (no file writes) proved the fold — 6 shown of 9, "3 more" opens to all 9 and flips to "show fewer", closes back to 6 — and a real pointer-drag on two fixture band headings reordered them end to end. The ONE line this task was allowed to write elsewhere landed clean: the mastermind's own log went from 292 to exactly 293 lines.

**Left alone, on purpose:** the fold count is one number for the whole tab, not per band — nothing has asked for a different cut per topic. No keyboard reorder for a band heading, same as the existing card/decision grips. The Report tab's own `links` pills (`AITask.links()`) were not touched.
